name: .308 Cal-181gr Hammer Hunter®

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "G7-BC=.272 calculated from shot drops" (calculated from shot drops).

slowestTwist.raw: Recommended twist rate is 1-9.5″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Big game hunting. The product page also says: "The 181gr Hammer Hunter™ is one of our most popular bullets. One of the 1st bullets that we designed. It has been a stellar performer for many hunters including us in our own rifles. Technically this bullet really needs a 1-9.5″ twist to be fully stable not the 1-10″ that it was previously advertised as. Those who have run this bullet well in your 1-10″ twist go ahead and continue with it. Other wise we recommend the 180gr Hammer Hunter™ for 1-10″ twist rifles." The product name says 181 gr; the specification says 180 gr.
